---
title: "Countering China’s trade coercion should be alliance agenda"
date: "2021-09-21"
categories: ["Economics", "Foreign Affairs & Defence", "Free Trade & Protectionism"]
---

I have an op-ed in the [AFR](https://www.afr.com/policy/foreign-affairs/countering-china-s-trade-coercion-should-be-alliance-agenda-20210920-p58tab%20) arguing that China’s economic statecraft, including its attempted coercion of Australia, has mostly been unsuccessful in promoting its geopolitical objectives and may prompt a collective allied response.
